Name: Spookfan's Smithing Exchange Program
Author: spookfan45
Description:
[center][b]About:[/b][/center]

Get to the bottom of the Pelican Town mines 3 times to unlock all three crafting recipes: Iron Half-Bar, Gold-Half Bar, and Iridium Thirds-Bar. There are trades available after the second year mark that are meant to be helpful, but should not impact players who would like to finish a full perfection file.  There's only three recipes to worry about. I wanted to keep this really simple and not require a lot of frameworks.

[center][b]What's Next?:[/b][/center]

I had some really cool stuff planned for this mod, but it relies on the figuring out how the game understands mine levels. I'd like to implement something for when the player reaches certain mine levels, but I can't quite figure this stuff out yet.

[center][b]Author Notes:[/b][/center]

This is my first mod uploaded to Nexus.  I hope you enjoy it!  I am open to comments and concerns.

Please do not re-upload on other platforms.

If anyone would like to help translate to something other than English, please let me know.

[center][b]Frameworks Required:[/b][/center]

[list]
[*]Shoptile Framework
[*]Json Assets
[*]Mail Framework Mod
[*]SMAPI

[/list]
